//! Ticket 13 closure fixture (written for FVS; not a real target).

pub fn helper(x: u32) -> u32 {
    if x > 100 { 100 } else { x }
}

pub fn sum_to(n: u32) -> u32 {
    let mut i = 0;
    let mut acc = 0;
    while i < n {
        acc = acc + i;
        i = i + 1;
    }
    acc
}

pub fn root_a(x: u32) -> u32 {
    helper(x)
}

pub fn root_b(x: u32) -> u32 {
    if x > 7 { helper(x) } else { sum_to(x) }
}

pub fn independent(x: u32) -> u32 {
    x
}
